name: HC-SR501 PIR motion sensor
blurb: Detects people and animals moving in front of it and raises its output pin for a few seconds; has dials for sensitivity and hold time.

pins.name: VCC
pins.note: Feed it 5 V. The board has its own 3.3 V regulator, which is why it accepts up to 20 V.

pins.name: OUT
pins.note: Goes high (about 3.3 V) when motion is seen and stays high for the hold time. Safe for 3.3 V controllers.

search: HC-SR501 adjustable IR pyroelectric infrared PIR module

verify: No drawing was opened. Measure with calipers: board 32 x 24 mm, dome diameter (23 mm assumed) and dome height above the PCB (14 mm assumed), dome centre, header position. Read the silkscreen for pin order: most boards print VCC OUT GND, some print GND OUT VCC. The 4.5 to 20 V supply range, about 50 uA idle and 65 mA peak figures come from typical listings and the BISS0001 reference design, not a datasheet opened here. The warm-up time after power-on is about a minute. OUT is about 3.3 V on genuine boards (Adafruit reports about 3 V); check yours with a meter if you wire it to a 1.8 V controller.
sources: https://learn.adafruit.com/pir-passive-infrared-proximity-motion-sensor/overview (opened: 5 to 12 V typical, regulator on board, output about 3 V high, no dimensions)
